rule: Every production device database is encrypted at rest with SQLCipher (or the platform equivalent). Opening without a key is allowed only in tests.
key_handling: The key lives in the platform keystore (Android Keystore, iOS Keychain, OS keyring) and is never stored beside the database or sent to the cloud.

implementations.rust: rusqlite with the bundled-sqlcipher feature (not built here)

status: reference rule only; no encrypted database has been opened in the build sandbox because SQLCipher is not installed there
